reason: Flood_Occurred (Day T) has a 0.9136 Pearson correlation with Flood_Next_Day (Day T+1). Floods in Odisha persist across multiple days (91.59% persistence rate). Using Flood_Occurred converts the model into a flood continuation detector rather than a rainfall-to-flood early warning system. A model trained with solely Flood_Occurred achieves 0.9356 Test ROC-AUC without looking at any rainfall. Furthermore, because real-time flood occurrence is unlabelled in operational 2025 inference, Flood_Occurred is forced to 0 at inference time, causing a catastrophic train-inference distribution shift.
